yeoni.enter: Welcome. I will guide you slowly, right by your side.
yeoni.breathe: Follow the light: breathe in for four, hold for four, out for six.
yeoni.incense: Press and hold the incense to light your heart.
yeoni.incenseLit: The incense is rising. Shall we offer our bows?
yeoni.bow: Each tap is one bow together. Three is enough.
yeoni.wish: Place one wish from your heart in the lantern.
yeoni.wishSent: The lantern is rising along the moonlight.
yeoni.dedication: May today’s offering reach you and everyone you hold dear.

cat.enter: You came! I’ll stay right beside you.
cat.breathe: Breathe with the light. In for four, hold four, out for six.
cat.incense: Press and hold the incense to light it.
cat.bow: Every tap, we bow once together. Three times.
cat.wish: Write just one wish on the lantern.
cat.dedication: Today’s wish will reach you and the people you love.
